```yaml
descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly Group Inventory
  description: Loads all Microsoft 365 groups, counts them by group type, and summarizes the landscape.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load Groups
    detail: Retrieves all Microsoft 365 groups with selected properties.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All
  - id: count_by_group_types
    format: transform
    label: Count Groups by Type
    detail: Counts the number of groups for each group type.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_groups.output }}"
      field: groupTypes
      buckets: []
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize Group Landscape
    detail: Generates a natural language summary of the group inventory.
    settings:
      system: "You are an assistant that summarizes Microsoft 365 group inventories."
      prompt: |
        Here are the counts of Microsoft 365 groups by type:
        {{ count_by_group_types.output }}
        Provide a concise summary of the group landscape.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 150
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: weekly
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data:
      groupCounts: "{{ count_by_group_types.output }}"
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top Non-Compliant Models
  description: Lists the oldest 10 non-compliant devices and summarizes their models.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load Managed Devices
    detail: Retrieves managed devices with selected properties.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count Devices by Compliance State
    detail: Counts devices grouped by complianceState.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown
  - id: sort_devices
    format: transform
    label: Sort Devices by Last Sync
    detail: Sorts devices by lastSyncDateTime ascending and takes the oldest 10.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize Device Data
    detail: Generates a natural language summary of the sorted device data.
    settings:
      system: You are an assistant that summarizes device compliance data.
      prompt: "Summarize the following device compliance data: {{ sort_devices.output }}"
      temperature: 0.7
      maxTokens: 150
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data:
      compliantCount: "{{ count_compliance.output.compliant }}"
      noncompliantCount: "{{ count_compliance.output.noncompliant }}"
      unknownCount: "{{ count_compliance.output.unknown }}"
```

```yaml
slug: dormant-guest-accounts
name: Dormant Guest Accounts
description: Identifies guest users in Microsoft 365 who have been inactive for a specified period and provides a summary of their status.
version: 1.0.0
author: OpenAdminOS
license: MIT
tags:
  - guest
  - dormant
  - summary
  - microsoft graph
  - lla
steps:
  - name: Load Guest Users
    type: graph
    description: Retrieve all guest users from Microsoft Graph.
    request:
      method: GET
      url: /users
      query:
        $filter: userType eq 'Guest'
        $select: id,displayName,userPrincipalName,signInActivity
      headers:
        Authorization: Bearer {{ .AuthToken }}
    output: guestUsers
  - name: Filter Dormant Guests
    type: function
    description: Filter guest users who have not signed in for the past 90 days.
    input: "{{ .guestUsers }}"
    function: filter
    args:
      predicate: |
        user => !user.signInActivity || !user.signInActivity.lastSignInDateTime || (new Date() - new Date(user.signInActivity.lastSignInDateTime)) > 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
    output: dormantGuests
  - name: Summarize Dormant Guests
    type: llm
    description: Generate a concise summary of dormant guest accounts.
    input: "{{ .dormantGuests }}"
    model: default
    prompt: |
      You are an assistant that summarizes lists of Microsoft 365 guest users who have been inactive for a long time.  
      Provide a short paragraph that includes the number of dormant guests, their display names, and any relevant details.  
      If there are no dormant guests, say "No dormant guest accounts found."
    output: summary
```
